tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: The projects of your team: each repository branch Agnes analyses, with its latest score.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The overall score, the score per category, the findings per category and severity, and which checks did not run, for a project's latest successful analysis.

tools.name: rank_fixes
tools.description: The rules whose findings cost the project the most points. Each entry says how many points the overall score and its category would gain if every finding of that rule were fixed (the report rescored without them), with one example finding.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: A project's findings, most severe first, 50 per page, with file, line, message and a documentation link where there is one. Filter by rule, category, severity or file (or folder).

tools.name: get_sbom
tools.description: The software bill of materials of a project's latest successful analysis (or the given run) as CycloneDX 1.6 JSON: every installed package with its purl, licence where known and dependencies, and the known vulnerabilities that affect them. Large for big projects; save it to a file rather than readin

tools.name: get_scoring
tools.description: How Agnes turns findings into scores: the categories, their weights in the overall score, and how severity, confidence and codebase size count.
